model.name: Ideogram 4.5 Precise Edit
model.shortDescription: Edit an image in place and leave the rest untouched: swap text, recolor, add or remove objects, with an optional mask and up to four reference images (three with a mask).

inputs.description: Describe the edit to apply. Say what must stay unchanged for the strictest result.
inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.name: prompt

inputs.description: The image to edit. The output keeps its size.
inputs.label: Image
inputs.name: image

inputs.description: Optional mask over the image. White marks the region to edit, black the region to keep.
inputs.label: Mask
inputs.name: mask

inputs.description: Optional images that guide the edit (up to 4, or 3 with a mask), such as a pose skeleton or a product to insert.
inputs.label: Reference Images
inputs.name: referenceImages

inputs.description: The quality-versus-speed tradeoff. High picks the best of several candidates: slower and costs more.
inputs.label: Quality
inputs.name: quality

inputs.description: How many images to generate (1-8). Each additional image adds to the cost.
inputs.label: Image Count
inputs.name: numOutputs

inputs.description: A number that locks in the randomness of the edit. Leave blank for a new result each time.
inputs.label: Seed
inputs.name: seed

inputs.description: Screens outputs for copyrighted content. Flagged images are withheld. Adds latency.
inputs.label: Copyright Detection
inputs.name: enableCopyrightDetection
